hybrid-phatt.description: Hybrid Phatt by The Disk King: a 90s-style ROM sound module for the MPC, styled as a cross between an MPC 60 and the E-mu Phatt. Layered presets (4 layers), filter, envelopes, LFOs, arpeggiator, grooves, FX and a KEYS page that lights up as you play the pads. Load your own E-mu .exb sound set (no sound bank included).

mpc-plugin-scanner.description: MPC Plugin Scanner by The Disk King: a safety check that runs on your MPC. It looks inside every installed plugin, from any maker, and gives each a light with the reasons: red RISKY (shell commands, wipe commands, hidden scripts, back doors, system changes), yellow CHECK (internet use), green CLEAN, and blue VERIFIED CREATOR for The Disk King's own official tools. Changes nothing, sends nothing.

trifecta-workstation.description: Trifecta Workstation by The Disk King: a 2000s-style workstation for the MPC with a blue touch screen, 512 programs and 512 combis, a VALUE dial, arpeggiator, chorus, delay and reverb. Plays its built-in Trifecta Voice synth. The original Korg Triton sounds cannot be included: bring your own (sound loading planned for 0.2). Early beta.

ashy-to-classy.description: Ashy to Classy by The Disk King: a vintage console insert effect for the MPC. The left side cleans up old records (hiss, crackle, pops, 60 Hz hum); the right side makes clean sounds dusty (vinyl noise, surface crackle, deep scratches, loop buzz). Ten keys, each with its own 4-fader mixer: eight stackable filters (Lo-Fi, Water, Dynamic, Tinny, Radio, Hollow, Sweep, Muffled) and a real analog Tape (drive, head bump, tone, wow). Four INPUT / OUTPUT meters in real dB and an amber 16 x 2 LCD. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

warm-front-compressor.description: Warm Front Compressor by The Disk King: a vintage analog-style stereo compressor insert effect for the MPC. CLASSIC (console bus glue with AUTO release), VINTAGE (opto/tube warmth) and MODERN styles, sidechain filter, INPUT / OUTPUT VU meters in real dB and a gain-reduction LED strip. 27 presets, 19 built from the published settings of famous studio compressors (console bus, FET, opto, vari-mu, VCA, diode). Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

reel-to-real.description: Reel-to-Real by The Disk King: a reel-to-reel tape machine insert effect for the MPC. Tape saturation, warmth, wow & flutter, tape speeds 3.75 to 30 ips, NAB / IEC tape EQ, hiss, tape stop and WAV recording. The reels really turn, the tape moves, the VU needles and the LED counter run. 11 presets. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

diskking-670-compressor.description: Diskking 670 Compressor by The Disk King: The Disk King's variation on the Fairchild 670 two-channel variable-mu tube limiter, as an MPC insert effect. Stepped input gain (1 dB clicks), threshold, six time constants (two program-dependent), Left-Right or Lat-Vert (mid/side), balance thump, gain-reduction meters that rest on 0. 10 presets: Mix Bus Glue TC2, Lat-Vert Bus TC5, Vocal Leveler TC1, Drum Squash TC1, Mastering TC3, Program Auto TC6, Bass Smooth TC4, Hard Limit TC2, Thump (Out of Bal), Clean Line Amp. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

dkx-160-compressor.description: The Disk King X, dkx 160 Compressor, inspired by the dbx 160. The Disk King's variation on the classic 1976 VCA compressor/limiter, as an MPC insert effect. True-RMS detection with automatic attack and release (the 160's punch), threshold 10 mV to 3 V, compression 1:1 to infinity, output gain +-20 dB, amber BELOW / red ABOVE lights, lamp-lit meter (input, output, gain change). 10 presets: Drum Bus Punch, Kick Punch, Snare Crack, Bass Leveler, Vocal Leveler, Drum Smash, Mix Bus Gentle, Peak Limiter 10:1, Hard Limit Inf, Clean Line Amp. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
